composition.why: The `runBfix` curve is composed by construction: 7 lambdas from the original run plus lambda=0.003 from a separate retrain. It reproduces the SAME composition used in the published target curve and Kodak curve, now with MS-SSIM in per_image. It is NOT a single run: always declare this.
composition.shared_point_note: Este ponto e o MESMO checkpoint em runBfix e runB8 (models/xray_full_v6_runB/lambda_0.003_best.pth.tar); contribui variancia ZERO entre as duas curvas, por construcao.
